question: Which statement best describes Dependencies?
options: A workspace lets one package manager coordinate related projects. Packages can reference each other locally, making shared changes easier to test before publishing.
A dependency is a library your project uses. A package manager downloads it, resolves its own dependencies, and records what the project needs.
A lockfile records exact package versions and their sources. Commit it so a teammate and CI install the same dependency tree.
package.json names dependencies and shared commands. Scripts such as build, lint, or test give a team consistent entry points.
explanation: A dependency is a library your project uses. A package manager downloads it, resolves its own dependencies, and records what the project needs.
